ValidationRule.description: Once an Original Term is recorded, a later renegotiation cannot push the current Term past it — "renegotiation cannot exceed the original 12" (client handoff fact), generalised to also cover a fleet plan's originally-approved longer term.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( ISBLANK( Original_Term_in_Months__c ) ), Term_in_Months__c > Original_Term_in_Months__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A renegotiated term cannot exceed the originally agreed term for this plan.
